question.text: IRDAI regulates all of the following EXCEPT:

explanation.text: The Logic: IRDAI regulates the insurance sector and insurance intermediaries, including life and general insurance companies, insurance brokers, and agents. Mutual fund entities and the funds they manage are regulated by SEBI, not IRDAI. The Trap: Unit-linked insurance products (ULIPs) sit on the insurance side of this boundary — they are insurance products and remain under IRDAI even though they have an investment component. Note: Source basis is p.92, pp.101-102, p.199, and p.204 of the NISM-Series-X-A Investment Adviser (Level 1) workbook (June 2025).
